gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.5: The road ends at a deep, dark gorge: the Trench. Walk to the edge and see who is waiting for you there.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.6: Go down the path, cross the bottom and climb up again on the other side. With a moustache you are scared of nothing... right?
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.6_b: They are singing along! Now climb up on the other side.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.7: A motorbike is coming... Walk along the road to Shell City.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.7_b: Run! Dennis is after you. Follow the road to the gate of Shell City.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.8: The crown is in the Cyclops' souvenir shop, on the square of Shell City. Go inside.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.8_b: Under the drying lamp! Help the tear across the table to the socket.
